primitives.name: Score Differential Spectrum
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S_{ij}': 'score differential between team i and team j (dimensionless)', 'T_i': 'total score of team i (points)'}
primitives.assumptions: Scores are deterministic within fixed time intervals; teams are distinguishable by static performance metrics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S_{ij} = 0, indicating tie or unknown outcome.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to eigenvalue decomposition of adjacency matrix of directed score graph.
layer2.telemetry: Match result confidence interval derived from variance of S_{ij}

primitives.name: Team Performance Graph
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'A_{ij}': 'adjacency weight from team i to team j (dimensionless)', 'D_i': 'degree of node i (number of matches played)'}
primitives.assumptions: Graph is weighted and directed; edge weights represent relative strength.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When A_{ij} = 0, indicating no known interaction or data gap.

layer2.mapping: Kernel derived from normalized adjacency matrix of performance graph.
layer2.telemetry: Centrality measure of team nodes in performance network

primitives.name: Match Outcome Distribution
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(S_{ij} = s)': 'probability of score differential s between teams i and j (dimensionless)', 's': 'specific score differential value (points)'}
primitives.assumptions: Outcomes follow discrete probability distribution; independence of match events.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When P(S_{ij} = s) approaches zero, indicating rare event occurrence.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to empirical cumulative distribution function of score differentials.
layer2.telemetry: Quantile-based prediction intervals for future match results
